arStrings.szText:
After opening a {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}, there is a low chance a Portal will open that will take you to the {c_important}Nemesis Lair{/c}, where you will fight two {c_important}Initiate Lair Bosses{/c} at the same time.

Slaying both will yield great rewards.

You cannot enter a {c_important}Nemesis Lair{/c} from Belial's throne room.
